format: html

  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

```

```{r}
billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  )

billboard_long |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  filter(week == max(week)) |>
  filter(week == 20) |>
  ungroup() |>
  summarise(
    songs = n(),
    ranked_below_50 = sum(rank > 50),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

billboard_summary <- billboard_long |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  summarise(
    first_rank = rank[which.min(week)],
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_at_best = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    total_weeks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

top_10_songs <- billboard_summary |>
  filter(best_rank <= 10)

notable_songs <- bind_rows(
  top_10_songs |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    slice_min(first_week_at_best, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    mutate(distinction = "Fastest to number one"),
  top_10_songs |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    slice_max(first_week_at_best, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    mutate(distinction = "Slowest to number one"),
  top_10_songs |>
    slice_max(total_weeks, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    mutate(distinction = "Longest chart run")
) |>
  select(distinction, artist, track, first_rank, best_rank, first_week_at_best, total_weeks)

print(notable_songs, width = Inf)

top_10_long <- billboard_long |>
  inner_join(top_10_songs |> select(artist, track), by = c("artist", "track")) |>
  left_join(
    notable_songs |>
      mutate(song_label = paste(artist, "-", track)) |>
      select(artist, track, song_label),
    by = c("artist", "track")
  )

highlight_labels <- paste(notable_songs$artist, "-", notable_songs$track)
highlight_colors <- setNames(
  c("#D55E00", "#0072B2", "#009E73"),
  highlight_labels
)

ggplot(
  top_10_long,
  aes(x = week, y = rank, group = interaction(artist, track))
) +
  geom_line(color = "grey75", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(top_10_long, !is.na(song_label)),
    aes(color = song_label),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Notable songs",
    values = highlight_colors,
    breaks = highlight_labels
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Top-10 Billboard song rankings over time",
    x = "Week on chart",
    y = "Rank"
  )
```
